commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Ricardo Ade (Haiti) tested Bono with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
90+6' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+5' Dominique Simon (Haiti) prepares to take a corner kick.
90+5' Duckens Nazon (Haiti) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the right side of the goal, but Bono is alert and thwarts the effort.
90+3' Josue Casimir (Haiti) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+1' Danny Makkelie sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!

89' Morocco take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

88' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Johny Placide to dive and make a save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Morocco.
88' Ricardo Ade (Haiti) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Morocco win a free kick.
87' Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

80' Duckens Nazon (Haiti) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
79' A yellow card for bad language! Johny Placide (Haiti) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.

78' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
77' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

77' Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Morocco.
75' The attendance for today's match is 68239.
75' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.

70' Mohamed Ouahbi prepares a substitution. Ismael Saibari is replaced by Soufiane Rahimi (Morocco).

65' Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
65' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.

64' Ayoub El Kaabi (Morocco) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Haiti earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
63' Danny Makkelie interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti).

60' Johny Placide makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom right corner.
59' The corner is swung in but Morocco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' Ayoub El Kaabi (Morocco) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
54' Josue Casimir (Haiti) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Danny Makkelie blows his whistle and it's Lenny Joseph (Haiti) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
51' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) takes it short.
48' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) but poses no threat.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+5' Neil El Aynaoui (Morocco) jumps highest on the edge of the box to connect with the ball from the free kick and produces a perfect goalward header! The keeper reacts coolly and makes an easy save.

45+4' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Johny Placide easily catches the ball.
45+4' Close! Brahim Diaz (Morocco) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Haiti will have a goal kick.
45+3' A cross from Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

45+1' 2 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Achraf Hakimi, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ismael Saibari (Morocco), who beats Johny Placide with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.

43' 1 - 2 Wilson Isidor (Haiti) scores one of the best goals in his career. His rocket of a shot from distance goes straight into the top left corner. They will be showing this on every football show for some time to come.
43' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
40' Danny Makkelie sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
40' Celebrations by Morocco are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
39' 1 - 1 Goal! 1:1. The ball rebounds to Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.

36' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Brahim Diaz, but sends his close-range header way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Haiti.
34' Lenny Joseph (Haiti) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Morocco.
31' Morocco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

30' Ayoub El Kaabi (Morocco) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner. However, he couldn't beat Johny Placide, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save. Corner kick. Morocco will have an opportunity.

30' A nice lofted cross finds Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save.
27' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
24' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.

23' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Johny Placide makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
22' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
17' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) is caught offside!
14' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
14' Ismael Saibari (Morocco) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
13' CHANCE! Ismael Saibari (Morocco) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and Haiti will have a goal kick.
13' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

13' Ayoub El Kaabi (Morocco) drives a shot towards the top right corner from inside the box, but Johny Placide leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away. The ball is out of play. Morocco will have a chance to score from a corner.
10' 0 - 1 Bono (Morocco) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
8' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
7' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Danny Makkelie blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Haiti.
6' Half-chance! Bilal El Khannouss (Morocco) plays a pass into the box, but Johny Placide reacts well to snuff out the attack.
3' Some great controlled play and passing from Morocco. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
